[[File:Ed Gartin People of Play 2021.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Gartin in 2021. Photo: People of Play.]]
'''Ed Gartin''' was a designer in Decipher's Art Department who handled flat and print media, and is credited on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref> In a 2021 profile he recalled that Decipher "needed a creative person to manage their art department", which is how he joined the games industry.<ref name="pop2021">[https://www.peopleofplay.com/blog/the-big-ideas-are-in-the-bag The BIG IDEAS are in the bag.], Ed Gartin, People of Play, 16 April 2021. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027195738/https://www.peopleofplay.com/blog/the-big-ideas-are-in-the-bag Internet Archive]</ref>
